LanguageData.SPR_Off: Another priority mod (Work Tab or Priority Master) is active, so this mod stays off.
LanguageData.SPR_Help: The Work tab uses priorities 1 to the number below instead of 1–4. Colonists do 1 first, then 2 and so on. Left click: more important, right click: less important (as in the base game). Changes count at once.
LanguageData.SPR_Scroll: Shift + mouse wheel changes a cell
LanguageData.SPR_ScrollTip: Hold Shift and turn the mouse wheel over a cell in the Work tab: up = more important, down = less important, below the last level = off.
LanguageData.SPR_ConvertHelp: Spread keeps the order of the old 1–4 priorities and spreads them over all levels (1 stays 1, 4 becomes the lowest). Before you remove this mod, use 'Back to 1–4' so nobody keeps a priority the game does not know.
LanguageData.SPR_NeedGame: Load a game to convert priorities.
